d:
4,500 years ago, the Indus Valley Civilization was home to highly organized cities with planned streets, standardized bricks and weights, advanced drainage systems, water management and long-distance trade with Mesopotamia.
Then, one day, it disappeared.
In this video, we explore the Indus Valley mystery and the unsolved mystery of the Indus Valley—from the discovery of Harappa and Mohenjo-Daro to the mysterious Indus Valley script that remains undeciphered.
